description.narrative: Oxfam in Cambodia, together with the Sustainable Business Alliance and OiC’s long-standing partner, Konrad Adenauer Stiftung (KAS),are collaborating to organize the ‘Waste Summit Cambodia X Cambodia Inclusive and Responsible Business Forum 2025’ to expand the IRB conversation more widely and drive IRB implementation in Cambodia, building on the more established brand of the Sustainable Business Alliance (SBA) and annual Waste Summit. Objective: 1) To build awareness of Cambodia’s key stakeholders on IRB, through discussion and exchange on the current landscape in Cambodia, key trends and challenges as well as good practices. 2) To promote IRB adoption through examples of actual cases: showcasing the IB certified businesses/SMEs practicing IRB. 3) To foster a network of IRB advocates and practitioners, through exchanges of learning, cases, and experiences from within Cambodia and other countries in Asia to inspire IRB take-up, and link regional developments to national level. 4) To respond to SMEs’expressed needs for market linkages and access to finance, through business matching event, and on IB accreditation through IB clinic/mentorship. Approach: To build on and benefit from the established brand and network of the annual Waste Summit Cambodia on which OiC and KAS usually collaborate, OiC will work with KAS team to co-create this event, blending both the Waste Summit and IRB Forum together. This is also to optimize from joint funding as well as gradually introduce the Inclusive and Responsible (IRB) concept, picking on the existing momentum in Cambodia for Inclusive Business (IB) that is based on the ASEAN IB Framework.

participating-org.narrative: Oxfam Novib is one of the 17 national affiliates of the Oxfam International Confederation. It started life in 1956 as the Netherlands Organisation for International Assistance (Novib), and joined forces with Oxfam in 1994. Working together in confederation, the Oxfam affiliates can speak with one clear and compelling voice on issues of global concern: climate change, health and education forall, agriculture, trade, and conflicts and emergencies. Oxfam established this country office to support local organizations and projects. Through this local office Oxfam Novib directly contributes towards this project#s implementation.
